Kazama Ritsu, shoulder still bandaged, appears from patient room, confirms patient presently stable under ventilation and ongoing unknown IV, requests corridor remain quiet; Kuroda agrees. Security continues searching for woman with altered temporary badge near north stairs, not captured or positively identified yet. Hospital lab assay not yet available; ANBU request still pending.
